tui.session_move.ambiguous: Use /move <path> for a working directory, or /move <session> --to <peer> to move a session.
tui.session_move.cannot_wait: this view cannot wait — from a shell: `lop sessions move <id> --to <to> --wait <seconds>`
tui.session_move.deadline_exceeded: the move did not finish in time; `lop sessions move {session} --to {to}` again reports where it got to
tui.session_move.cli_no_answer: the CLI exited {code} with no answer
